en: A black and white historical postcard showing a train station scene. People are standing beside a wooden building (the station) and next to a train marked with 'WBJ'. The postcard has handwritten and printed text at the bottom, and it appears to be dated 1902. The station sign and the structure are visible, and the setting suggests an early 20th-century European rural railway station.
